name: A New Threat
summary: Balir Frosthammer calls for help as troggs surge through Coldridge Valley. Rockjaw troggs are breaking through across Dun Morogh, catching dwarven mountaineers off guard and threatening the settlements and camps.

sections.title: Breaching Coldridge Valley
sections.body: In Coldridge Valley, Rockjaw troggs are clawing up from below in growing numbers. Anvilmar hears reports of them swarming the frozen lake and nearby foothills. Their attacks disrupt patrols and cut off supply routes through the valley pass, turning a training refuge for young dwarven warriors and mountaineers into a place under threat.

sections.title: A Camp Overrun
sections.body: A dwarven camp west of the valley has fallen to a coordinated trogg attack. The mountaineers retreated and abandoned their posts. Ironforge cannot spare full battle regiments, so Balir Frosthammer calls on newly recruited adventurers to fight through the Rockjaw ranks and secure the hills before the creatures reach Anvilmar.

faq.answer: Balir Frosthammer is a seasoned dwarven mountaineer stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He organizes defenses against wild beasts and troggs threatening local recruits.

faq.q: Why are troggs suddenly in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs are tunneling up from deep fissures across Dun Morogh. Coldridge Valley is among the first populated valleys struck as the creatures break through and overrun surface camps.

faq.q: What camp was overrun by the troggs?
faq.answer: Troggs overwhelmed a dwarven mountaineer camp in the western reaches of Coldridge Valley. The survivors fell back toward Anvilmar.

faq.q: What kind of troggs are threatening the valley?
faq.answer: The attackers belong to the Rockjaw tribe. Standard Rockjaw Troggs and larger, sturdier Burly Rockjaw Troggs lead the advance around the frozen lake and foothills.

faq.q: Is King Magni aware of the trogg problem?
faq.answer: Local guards hope King Magni Bronzebeard and the Ironforge Senate are preparing a wider response. For now, frontier outposts like Coldridge Valley must face the surges on their own.

faq.q: What happens after culling these troggs?
faq.answer: Thinning the troggs helps steady Anvilmar's immediate surroundings. Balir and other dwarven officers continue to organize counterattacks to reclaim the western camp and drive the troggs underground.

angles.text: As a young Bronzebeard dwarf leaving Anvilmar, you have a personal duty to drive back the troggs and protect Dun Morogh's sacred grounds and tunnels.
As an Alliance recruit, you help contain the subterranean threat in Coldridge Valley, keeping Ironforge's training grounds viable and the southern mountain gate secure.
